entities.summary: Clemens Heinrich Krauss was an Austrian conductor and opera impresario, particularly associated with the music of Richard Strauss, Johann Strauss and Richard Wagner. He founded the New Year's Concert of the Vienna Philharmonic and conducted it until 1954. Clemens Krauss was a writers & intellectuals from Vienna (1893-03-31, Vienna–1954-05-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
